# Founder Plan

Your business planner, and the last step of the founder pack. The bundled tool compile.py first checks what exists in the founder/ folder and computes the verdict from the numbers, never by hand: Profitable only if each unit earns money before fixed costs, year 1 makes an operating profit, the break-even point fits inside capacity when a capacity was given, and enough simulated buyers buy (25 percent by default, adjustable with a flag the user must justify). Otherwise the verdict is Not yet, with the failing numbers named, or Incomplete, with each missing section listed next to the skill that fills it. The skill then writes a half-page summary in plain words (the business, the verdict and the three numbers behind it, where the board and the panel agreed and disagreed, the biggest risk, what is needed to start, and the one thing to do this week), compiles founder/business-plan.md from every section the pack produced, and writes a one-page version for a partner, lender or investor with the same numbers word for word. The file states once that the panel is simulated buyers and the numbers are projections, and that this is not financial, legal or tax advice.
